decisions.reason: Adding the current board to JLCPCB for order and availability review does not change the existing component-selection or sourceability policies; any review outcome would require separate evidence.
The source establishes a JLCPCB order-setup action but does not change the required BOM contents, correctness criteria, or board-specific BOM deliverables.
Adding a board to JLCPCB does not alter the sensor-board production-file package or its required files.
The JLCPCB setup request does not establish or change any requirement concerning KiCad project portability or library resolution.
Manufacturer order setup does not change the confirmed ESP32-S3 GPIO assignments or compatibility constraints.
The phrase 'current board' does not identify or modify the separately proposed future direct-sensor integration board.
Adding the board to JLCPCB does not change the e-paper backlight circuit, population choices, or electrical specifications.
The order-setup action does not modify the modular boards' connector types, pinouts, or power and signal topology.
The JLCPCB setup request does not alter the AXP2101 battery, USB, charging, or rail requirements.
Manufacturer order setup does not change the enclosure's hardware fit, mounting, airflow, or assembly requirements.
Adding the board to JLCPCB does not modify the active-low panel-input configuration or pull-up implementation requirements.
The order-setup action does not change the battery connector's placement, orientation, clearance, or enclosure accessibility constraints.
